author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I don’t want in-wall fittings for this PEX stub-out. One solution is the HoldRite ProGuard Bend Support. This slides into a stout bracket (SB3) and bends the PEX without kinking it. I then plug the PEX with a SharkBite Max end cap. This is just one way to stub-out PEX for toilets or sinks
